description: Retrieve UniRef50/90 cluster sizes for FdeD and FdeE, then write the evidence matrix, GO decision table and partner-class comparison table as artifacts with a summary figure
code:
import requests, os, pandas as pd, numpy as np
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
OUT = os.getcwd(); print("writing artifacts to:", OUT)

sizes = {}
for acc in ["D8J0W8","D8J0W9"]:
    for ident in ["50","90"]:
        r = requests.get(f"https://rest.uniprot.org/uniref/UniRef{ident}_{acc}.json",
                         params=dict(fields="id,count,name"), timeout=60)
        if r.ok:
            j = r.json(); sizes[(acc,ident)] = j.get("memberCount")
            print(f"UniRef{ident}_{acc}: {j.get('memberCount')} members  |  {j.get('name','')}")
        else:
            print(f"UniRef{ident}_{acc}: not retrievable (HTTP {r.status_code})")
if ("D8J0W8","50") in sizes and ("D8J0W9","50") in sizes:
    print("UniRef50 ratio FdeE/FdeD = %.1f" % (sizes[("D8J0W9","50")]/sizes[("D8J0W8","50")]))

EV = pd.DataFrame([
 dict(citation="PMID 27059806", evidence_type="direct assay", stance="qualifies",
      claim="FdeE and FdeC catalyse steps of naringenin degradation",
      finding="FdeE hydroxylates naringenin to 5,7,8-trihydroxyflavanone with NADPH alone; FdeC cleaves the A ring",
      context="H. seropedicae SmR1, purified enzymes in vitro",
      confidence="high for the activities; the assay does not test any role for FdeD"),
 dict(citation="PMID 39107441", evidence_type="direct assay", stance="refutes",
      claim="FdeD is the reductase of FdeE",
      finding="FdeE is the FMO of H. seropedicae SmR1; Pfam PF01494 (FAD_binding_3), a single-component class A flavoprotein monooxygenase reduced directly by NAD(P)H",
      context="H. seropedicae SmR1 enzyme used as a biocatalyst",
      confidence="high; class A FMOs need no external electron carrier, so the KEGG link of FdeD to the FdeE step is pathway co-membership"),
 dict(citation="PMID 36038906", evidence_type="direct assay", stance="supports",
      claim="A flavonoid hydroxylase of this family works without a Rieske partner",
      finding="RgF8H, a flavonoid C8-hydroxylase, requires NADPH for prosthetic group regeneration and has no ferredoxin partner",
      context="Rhodotorula glutinis, purified enzyme",
      confidence="moderate; functional analogue, not an ortholog of FdeE"),
 dict(citation="PMID 9888813 / 26309236", evidence_type="direct assay", stance="competing",
      claim="Small Rieske proteins of 100-125 aa serve diiron monooxygenases",
      finding="T4moC is obligately required for electron transfer between the oxidoreductase and the diiron hydroxylase of toluene-4-monooxygenase",
      context="Pseudomonas mendocina KR1, reconstituted four-protein complex",
      confidence="high for T4moC; SmR1 encodes no diiron BMM hydroxylase, so this class has no acceptor in this genome"),
 dict(citation="PMID 17240981", evidence_type="direct assay", stance="qualifies",
      claim="Partner class is a functional constraint, not a fold property",
      finding="Of T4moC, TbuB, the Thermus Rieske protein and BphF, all except BphF complemented T4MO; T4moC belongs to a clade specialised for diiron hydroxylases",
      context="purified ferredoxins, reconstituted T4MO assay",
      confidence="high; justifies treating FdeD's failure to match any clade as informative"),
 dict(citation="PMID 8344270", evidence_type="mutant phenotype", stance="competing",
      claim="A small ferredoxin next to an extradiol dioxygenase reactivates it",
      finding="xylT deletion drops catechol 2,3-dioxygenase activity on p-toluate to 1 percent of wild type",
      context="Pseudomonas putida TOL plasmid meta-cleavage operon",
      confidence="high for the paradigm; XylT is a plant-type four-Cys ferredoxin, not Rieske-type"),
 dict(citation="PMID 11889489", evidence_type="direct assay", stance="competing",
      claim="The reactivating ferredoxin acts directly on the dioxygenase",
      finding="CbzT, CdoT and AtdS are [2Fe-2S] proteins; CbzT reactivates 4-methylcatechol-inactivated CbzE in vitro and cross-links to it",
      context="Pseudomonas spp., purified proteins",
      confidence="high for the mechanism; structural class differs from FdeD"),
 dict(citation="PMID 12297005", evidence_type="direct assay", stance="competing",
      claim="XylT-dependent reactivation generalises to oxidative inactivation",
      finding="XylT restores H2O2-oxidised XylE; cysteines at 41, 46, 49 and 81 define the plant-type cluster site",
      context="purified XylE and XylT",
      confidence="high; confirms FdeD's ligand set is of a different type"),
 dict(citation="this work, computational", evidence_type="structural/evolutionary", stance="qualifies",
      claim="The fold of FdeD identifies its partner class",
      finding="AlphaFold D8J0W8 superposes on 1FQT 1.51 A / 83 CA, 1VM9 1.34 A / 82 CA, 1RIE 1.67 A / 80 CA; spread 0.33 A",
      context="AlphaFold DB model_v6, mean pLDDT 94.81; Kabsch fit seeded on the four cluster ligands",
      confidence="direct computational result; the fold is uninformative for partner assignment"),
 dict(citation="this work, computational", evidence_type="structural/evolutionary", stance="qualifies",
      claim="FdeD belongs to a characterised Rieske partner class",
      finding="Inter-cysteine spacing 24 (fde homologs 24-29) against 18-21 in all 21 reviewed references; CPH triad matches diiron-BMM 3/3 vs ring-hydroxylating 0/14 (Fisher p=0.0015); best identity 23.4 percent",
      context="UniProt reviewed PF00355 proteins 80-170 aa with assigned partners",
      confidence="direct computational result; n=3 for the diiron-BMM class limits the triad inference"),
 dict(citation="this work, computational", evidence_type="computational", stance="supports",
      claim="fdeD is present wherever the rest of the fde locus is present",
      finding="58 of 65 fdeE-containing genomes (89.2 percent) carry a small Rieske gene within 6 genes of fdeE, 57 of 65 (87.7 percent) within 2 genes; 8 genomes lack one",
      context="NCBI IPG plus region-restricted CDS retrieval around fdeE homologs",
      confidence="direct computational result; absences may be assembly or annotation gaps, so 89.2 percent is a lower bound"),
 dict(citation="this work, computational", evidence_type="computational", stance="supports",
      claim="The four cluster ligands are conserved in fde-locus homologs",
      finding="40 of 40 collected homologs retain Cys, His, Cys, His with first triad CPH in all cases; no ligand lost",
      context="fdeD homologs from the neighbourhood scan",
      confidence="direct computational result; conservation argues the cluster is functional but not what it does"),
 dict(citation="UniProt D8J0W8 (database record)", evidence_type="review/database", stance="refutes",
      claim="FdeD has hydroxyethylthiazole kinase activity",
      finding="The record carries EC 2.7.1.50 and GO:0004417 with evidence IEA:UniProtKB-EC, inherited from the EMBL submission; the only domain content is PF00355 / PS51296 / SSF50022",
      context="UniProtKB unreviewed entry, 112 aa",
      confidence="high; a 112 aa Rieske protein cannot carry a thiazole kinase domain, so this is database carry-over"),
])
EV.to_csv(f"{OUT}/table_evidence_matrix.csv", index=False)

GOD = pd.DataFrame([
 dict(go_id="GO:0051537", term="2 iron, 2 sulfur cluster binding", aspect="MF", lead="retain",
      basis="Four intact ligands in FdeD and 40 of 40 homologs; PF00355, PS51296, IEA:InterPro",
      confidence="high at sequence level"),
 dict(go_id="GO:0046872", term="metal ion binding", aspect="MF", lead="retain as parent",
      basis="Implied by the cluster site", confidence="high"),
 dict(go_id="GO:0009055", term="electron transfer activity", aspect="MF",
      lead="acceptable as a lead; do not make more specific",
      basis="Rieske clusters are redox centres, but no assay exists and no partner is assignable",
      confidence="moderate; no direct evidence in any organism"),
 dict(go_id="ring-hydroxylating ferredoxin terms", term="e.g. oxidoreductase-partner MF terms", aspect="MF",
      lead="do not add",
      basis="FdeD falls outside the ring-hydroxylating clade by spacing, triad and identity; no RO oxygenase and no reductase in the locus",
      confidence="high as a negative"),
 dict(go_id="GO:0004417", term="hydroxyethylthiazole kinase activity", aspect="MF", lead="remove",
      basis="EC 2.7.1.50 carried over from the EMBL submission ADJ62523.1; no kinase domain present",
      confidence="high; database carry-over"),
 dict(go_id="flavonoid catabolic process", term="BP term for naringenin degradation", aspect="BP",
      lead="add only with an inferred-by-curator qualifier, or leave pending",
      basis="Locus membership and 87.7 percent synteny with fdeE; no mutant phenotype for fdeD exists",
      confidence="moderate; genomic context (IC/ISS), not experiment"),
 dict(go_id="GO:0005515", term="protein binding", aspect="MF", lead="do not use as a final recommendation",
      basis="Uninformative while the partner is unidentified", confidence="n/a"),
])
GOD.to_csv(f"{OUT}/table_go_decision.csv", index=False)

CMP = pd.DataFrame([
 dict(partner_class="Ring-hydroxylating oxygenase ferredoxin", example="BphF, NdoA, HcaC, TodB, DntAb",
      n_reviewed=14, spacing="19-20", first_triad="C[T/S]H",
      candidate_in_SmR1="Hsero_1308, 1341, 3664, 3834 oxygenases; 0460, 3992", in_fde_locus="no",
      verdict="excluded: no RO oxygenase in the locus; Hsero_1308-1310 already has its own reductase"),
 dict(partner_class="Diiron bacterial multicomponent monooxygenase", example="T4moC, XamoC, MsmC",
      n_reviewed=3, spacing="19-20", first_triad="CPH", candidate_in_SmR1="none genome-wide",
      in_fde_locus="no", verdict="excluded by the genome, although FdeD shares the CPH triad"),
 dict(partner_class="bc1 / b6f Rieske iron-sulfur protein", example="QcrA, PetC",
      n_reviewed=2, spacing="18-21", first_triad="C[T/K]H",
      candidate_in_SmR1="Hsero_1888 nitrite-reductase-type Rieske; respiratory bc1 elsewhere",
      in_fde_locus="no", verdict="excluded: FdeD has no membrane anchor and is not in a bc1 operon"),
 dict(partner_class="VOC extradiol dioxygenase reactivation (XylT paradigm)", example="XylT, CbzT, CdoT, AtdS",
      n_reviewed=4, spacing="n/a, plant-type four-Cys", first_triad="n/a",
      candidate_in_SmR1="FdeC, Hsero_1005, PF00903, 45 bp upstream", in_fde_locus="yes",
      verdict="only locus-internal candidate; the precedent is functional, not structural"),
])
CMP.to_csv(f"{OUT}/table_partner_class_comparison.csv", index=False)
print("\nartifacts written:", sorted(f for f in os.listdir(OUT) if f.startswith("table_")))
print("\n", CMP[["partner_class","n_reviewed","spacing","first_triad","in_fde_locus"]].to_string(index=False))

fig, ax = plt.subplots(1, 3, figsize=(14.2, 4.3))
ax[0].bar(["present\nwithin 6 genes","present\nwithin 2 genes","absent"], [58,57,8],
          color=['#2a7f62','#2a7f62','#b03a2e'])
for i,v in enumerate([58,57,8]):
    ax[0].text(i, v+1.2, f"{v}/65\n{100*v/65:.1f}%", ha='center', fontsize=9)
ax[0].set_ylim(0,74); ax[0].set_ylabel("genomes carrying fdeE")
ax[0].set_title("fdeD co-occurrence with the fde locus", fontsize=11)
ax[1].bar(["all four ligands\nretained","any ligand\nlost"], [40,0], color=['#2a7f62','#b03a2e'])
ax[1].text(0, 41.5, "40/40 (100%)", ha='center', fontsize=9); ax[1].text(1, 1.5, "0/40", ha='center', fontsize=9)
ax[1].set_ylim(0,50); ax[1].set_ylabel("fdeD-like homologs")
ax[1].set_title("Rieske cluster ligand conservation", fontsize=11)
cls = ["RO\nferredoxin","diiron\nBMM","bc1 / b6f","VOC\nreactivation"]
x = np.arange(4); w = 0.38
ax[2].bar(x-w/2, [1,0,1,1], w, label="candidate anywhere in SmR1", color='#4c72b0')
ax[2].bar(x+w/2, [0,0,0,1], w, label="candidate inside the fde locus", color='#dd8452')
ax[2].set_xticks(x); ax[2].set_xticklabels(cls, fontsize=9)
ax[2].set_yticks([0,1]); ax[2].set_yticklabels(["no","yes"]); ax[2].set_ylim(0,1.6)
ax[2].set_title("Where each partner class could be satisfied", fontsize=11)
ax[2].legend(fontsize=8.5, loc='upper left')
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
